description: Small figure with height bracket and label shrinks progressively and settles lower-left across all 8 tiles; bracket and label shrink with it.
Large tusked animal enters from the right edge: tusk tips only at f3636, trunk/head by f3640, almost full body with fur tuft by f3643; it also grows/moves leftward. Entry from right, tusks lead.

Big cat plus stick figure in its jaws shrinks and moves down-right across tiles (face fills frame at f3802, whole cat body visible by f3809): pull-back. Whether camera or object scale is not separable.

Label text slides in from the left edge moving rightward: only the END of the word is visible first ('ea' at f3802, 'laea' f3804, 'pelaea' f3806, 'spelaea' f3807, 'hera spelaea' f3809) so the right end of the text appears first and earlier letters follow. Left part may be hidden by the tile label box only at top rows; text is lower so this is a genuine slide.
Ice landscape and bone hut static; bearded figure shows small left-right wobble and slight size change (a few tile px); no zoom or pan visible.
Same scene; figure drifts slightly left and changes size by a few tile px while landscape and hut stay put.
Second bearded figure on a hide mat is absent at f4058 (hide bundle visible) and present at right at f4059 (appears within one tile step), then grows/rises f4059-f4062.
Third smaller figure appears in front-left of the second at f4063 and stays; first figure and fire unchanged.

Crowd of 7+ figures to the right of fire; a larger figure appears at left front of the group at f4085 and positions change in f4086-f4089; figures overlap and shift size per tile. Exact pop sequence not resolvable from 8 tiles.
Giant hand holding a blue suit rises from the figure side toward upper right; suit moves up and right and is mostly outside frame by f4162-f4163 (hand partly visible at top right).
Wardrobe sign and rack drift slightly leftward (sign left edge moves a few tile px) while hand leaves; small, background-wide.
Giant hand enters from upper right carrying an orange patchwork tunic and brings it left and down in front of the figure torso; tunic overlaps the figure by f4201-f4202.
Figure with tunic and stick on snow nearly static for f4385-f4389; background ice drifts slightly.
A dark grey arc (edge of an object) starts appearing at the right frame edge at f4390 and is larger at f4392; identity of object only inferable from next strip.
Tusked mammoth enters from the right edge: tusk tips at f4400, head with eye by f4404, fur tuft at top by f4406-f4407; moves leftward and downward into frame.
Background mountains move left/scale; figure height roughly constant: background-and-subject relation changes slightly (possible pull-back or parallax); not separable.
Hut with EMERGENCY sign holds still f4756-f4758 (position identical in three tiles), then moves right and out of frame by f4762-f4763 (sliver at f4763).

Hut enters from the left edge moving right: sliver at f4733, half at f4735, almost whole by f4736, rests by about f4739; per-frame step shrinks toward the end (no curve claimed). Sign text EMERGENCY is cut from its left end first as the hut enters.

Image on board appears from a thin faint horizontal strip (f5113) to a taller faint rectangle (f5114-f5115) to full opacity at f5116 and settled size by f5117; vertical expansion plus fade-in over about 4-5 frames. Faint greenish haze near top-left at f5113-f5114.
Image holds f5167-f5168, fades from f5169, collapses to a thin faint strip by f5171-f5172; at f5174 another faint horizontal strip (new image beginning) is visible.

f5426-f5428 wide framing with tiny figures and central hill; f5429 jumps to a closer framing with larger figures and hill at right; no intermediate scale frame, so a cut or very fast jump between f5428 and f5429. f5429-f5433 near static with minor figure drift.
Slow growth of figures and horizon shift across the 8 tiles (figures larger and lower in frame by f5527); right-hand figure changes head/eye direction over the strip.
Close-up face sways side to side by tile-scale tens of px (head right at f6243, left at f6244-f6245), eyes glance and mouth shape shifts; background static.

Black rectangle widens rightward (f6260 small, f6262 wider); text 'Welcome to the' is uncovered left to right: 'We' at f6263, 'Welcome' f6264, 'Welcome to t' f6265, 'Welcome to the' f6266; the FIRST letters appear first and the black block sits at the trailing/right end; a thin bar remains at f6267. Block-cursor typewriter-like; software not claimed.

Second line 'Dawn of' pops in at centre tiny (f6284), mid size (f6285), larger than final (f6286), then settles slightly smaller by f6288; whole phrase appears at once (not letter by letter) with an overshoot-like scale; first line unchanged.
Header 'Before farming' lowers from the top edge (cropped at f6340) to its resting position by about f6344 and holds; figure static.
'Before farming' header and figure translate leftward by tens of tile px across the strip while the right panel enters.
Gaunt ribbed figure and 'After farming' header enter from the right edge sliding left: header 'After' at f6371, 'After farm' f6373, fuller by f6375-f6378; header and figure move together.

Farmer swings a hoe from overhead (f6499) through horizontal-left (f6501) to resting on the ground at left (f6503); body dips slightly at f6502-f6503; holds with small variations f6504-f6506. Hut static.

Whole scene shifts and pulls back across the strip: horizon and hill move, huts shrink a little, a second hut with an occupant and two rows of sprouts enters from the left edge; farmer repeats the hoe swing (up f6551, down by f6554).
Wheat sprig static f6688-f6690, moves right at f6691, much further at f6692, mostly off frame at f6693, blank white at f6694-f6695.
Grain pile enters from the left edge: sliver f6716, partial f6717, mostly in f6718, further right f6719, rests by f6720-f6723; leading end is its right side.
Board text and classroom static; teacher head and board edge show only a few tile px of drift.
Closed book enters from the left edge (right edge visible at f6843, nearly whole at f6845) moving right with a slight rotation; still moving at f6850.
Closed book (not a character) tilts slightly and shifts across f6892-f6894.
Closed book at f6894 is replaced at f6895 by an open book showing four checklist lines with empty boxes; no intermediate open-in-progress frame seen; all four lines present at once.
Open book grows slightly and drifts across f6895-f6899.
Continuous zoom-in from medium shot (face plus plate) to extreme close-up of face/mouth over 8 tiles; plate drops out of the bottom edge by f7234-f7235.
Mouth is closed at f7228-f7229 and shows an open mouth with decayed teeth at f7230 and on; swap occurs between f7229 and f7230 (single-tile step).
Continuous zoom-out from extreme close-up mouth to medium dining view over 8 tiles; table and plate with leaf visible again from f7299-f7300.
Open decayed-teeth mouth at f7298 and closed mouth at f7299 (swap in one tile step); leaf plate appears at the bottom at f7299.
